thesis: The conversation argues that traditional policing often fails to investigate crimes where no one was physically hurt, whereas Flock Safety's technology enables real-time monitoring that allows for the rapid recovery of stolen items like firearms. The speakers explain that the company evolved from a single neighborhood camera prototype that solved specific crimes to a platform deployed in over 6,000 cities that helped clear more than a million crimes in the last year.
